newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bastia airport freight & mail decline 4.1pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Bastia airport freight & mail decline 4.1pct in 96.

text.p: Bastia's Poretta airport handled 1,945 tonnes of airfreight in 1996, a decrease of 4.1 percent on the previous year.
Air France Europe is the principal airline operator at Bastia with daily passenger services between Paris-Orly and the northern Corsican city using Airbus 320 series aircraft.

Bastia is also served by French airline, Air Littoral, which operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft.
Postal traffic totalled 5,786 tonnes, up 18.3 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
